k1s Dynamic Honeycomb SVG

Files:
- honeycomb-hex-dynamic.svg
- honeycomb-hex-dynamic-nolabel.svg
- example-theme.css

How it works:
These SVGs use CSS variables (e.g., --accent) so you can set any namespace color dynamically.

Usage example:
<svg class="k1s-hex k1s-ns-custom" style="--accent: rgba(180,90,255,0.95); --label: #e8eaed"></svg>
